formulaBlock.normalization: No split entries; positions = packet order (normalized, one-based).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate (C1): Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) defining anionic, buffered by the prominent mild anionics Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate (5) and Sodium Lauroyl Glutamate (7); no reinforcing strong anionic. Laureth-2 (3) is a thickener, not a route.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: No amphoteric buffer; buffers are mild anionics only. Convention still applies.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate (bounded): one cationic conditioning polymer Polyquaternium-7 (13) with Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein (17) and Panthenol (4). C2 not met (no silicone, lipid or pearlizing route).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Polyquaternium-7 is a light conditioner listed after salts/acids; a cleansing-led low reading is realistic.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: one light late polymer (Polyquaternium-7, 13) and a late hydrolyzed protein (17) against an effective buffered SLES chassis.

persistence.rationale: Light polymer and small hydrolyzed protein, weakly retained.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 SLES buffered by sulfosuccinate and glutamate.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Two light, late routes with moderate reset: low anchor.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: two families present, but both sit after salt and acids (13, 17), PQ-7 is a light polymer and the protein is hydrolyzed; no silicone, lipid or film converges, and the SLES chassis offsets them.

focusPrimary.rationale: Pending claims. Caffeine (9), Zinc PCA (15), Niacinamide (16), Camellia Sinensis (14) suggest scalp/hair-loss or oily-scalp positioning; caffeine is not a focus route (F5). Lengths care-direction: nonspecific.

usageRole.rationale: Default; moderate cleansing excludes alternating; frequent possible with frequency wording.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No positioning yet. CSA formula half met: prominent Panthenol (4) and Niacinamide (16) comfort routes.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole; Zinc PCA is not a recognized active under Section 11.

formulaFacts.role: hair-loss-associated ingredient, not a focus route (F5)
